summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated undeclared payload at package root
details: The package declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads a pinned Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file math_init.js at the tarball root. math_init.js is a ~727KB Bun-CJS artifact (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) containing an obfuscator.io-style string-array rotator (`WV8StW` shifting a ~2000-element mixed literal/number array) and hex-mangled identifiers; its contents are not human-readable and cannot be inspected without executing under Bun. math_init.js is not listed in the package.json `files` array (declared as ["dist","src"]), so it is an undeclared payload smuggled at the tarball root. The visible dist/index.js is a plausible microfrontend helper, consistent with a trojanized publish that preserves the original API surface while adding the dropper. The alternate-runtime execution channel (Bun rather than Node) bypasses Node-only auditing tooling and hides the payload behavior from static inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
